**Greece: scale and change.** Across 2000–2025, the extract records 936,901 applications. The largest annual volume was 92,673 in 2019; 2025 recorded 74,139. Applications in 2025 were 20% lower than in 2019 (92,673). In 2025, 70,843 recorded decisions equated to 96 per 100 applications, so recorded output fell below incoming volume. Applications in 2025 were 13% lower than in 2024 (85,674). Applications exceeded recorded decisions in 2 of 5 comparable years during 2021-2025. The leading recorded origins that year were Afghanistan (15,489), Egypt (14,119), Sudan (8,204).

In 2025, the substantive protection rate was 56%, across 48,472 grants and refusals; closures accounted for 32% of all recorded decisions. That protection rate was 12.8 percentage points lower than in 2024 (69%).
